skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that share a common denominator.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer or whole-number components in problems involving mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Fraction Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole-number part to add to the fraction part when the fraction subtraction results in a negative value.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction or the fractional part of a mixed number to its lowest terms.
